The event dates associated with this record are 2026-01-28, 2026-05-07, 2026-06-17, 2026-08-19, and 2026-08-21.

The compliance file therefore contains measure identifiers, measure names, units, reporting periods, numerators, denominators, exclusions, rates, and event dates for both submitted measures. Accordingly, this narrative is limited to the reported measure data and does not characterize performance as meeting or failing any external standard.
